pages.text: In 1865 Kekule dreamt of a snake seizing its own tail, and woke knowing the shape of benzene: a ring of six carbons. Use $(item)Kekule's Dream$() in Titan's $(thing)Selk Crater$() and a serpent of six segments rises, its tail in its mouth.

It is $(thing)aromatic$(): while the ring is closed, its electrons belong to the whole ring, and every blow is shared round all six bonds - it takes a quarter of the damage. Every twenty seconds it lets go of its tail for five (its eyes turn red and its bar goes red): then it takes double damage, but its head lunges at you. Closed, it spits tholin at everyone it can see.

At half health two Catalyst Sprites come to it, and they heal it as they heal everything of Titan: kill them first. It leaves a $(item)Kekule Ring$() and a pile of tholin. The ring never wears: held in a Polymeriser's catalyst slot, it turns Organic Evaporite and ammonia straight into $(item)Aramid Fibre$() (Kevlar is a ring of six carbons, repeated). Kekule's Dream can be crafted again from tholin, evaporites and amino acids, so the Ouroboros can always be called again.
